# Power calculation for F-test of overall regression significance
# H0: R² = 0 vs H1: R² > 0 (with ρ = 0.30)

# Parameters
n <- 80                    # sample size (participants)
p <- 3                     # number of predictors (excluding intercept)
rho <- 0.30                # multiple correlation coefficient under H1
alpha <- 0.05              # significance level (one-sided)

# Derived quantities
R_squared <- rho^2         # coefficient of determination
df_numerator <- p          # degrees of freedom for regression
df_denominator <- n - p - 1  # degrees of freedom for residual

# Noncentrality parameter
# λ = [R² / (1 - R²)] × [(n - p - 1) / p]
lambda <- (R_squared / (1 - R_squared)) * (df_denominator / df_numerator)

# Critical F value from central F(p, n-p-1) at α = 0.05
F_critical <- qf(1 - alpha, df_numerator, df_denominator)

# Power: P(F > F_critical | H1 is true)
# Under H1, the test statistic follows noncentral F(df_num, df_den, λ)
power <- 1 - pf(F_critical, df_numerator, df_denominator, ncp = lambda)

# Display results

cat(sprintf("  Test statistic:                     F-statistic from overall regression\n\n")

cat("Step 1: R-squared calculation\n")
cat(sprintf("  ρ = %.2f\n", rho))
cat(sprintf("  R² = ρ² = %.4f\n\n", R_sq))

# Step 2: Degrees of freedom
df_reg <- p                    # regression df (number of predictors)
df_res <- n - p - 1            # residual df
df_total <- n - 1              # total df
cat("Step 2: Degrees of freedom\n")
cat(sprintf("  df_regression (numerator):   %d\n", df_reg))
cat(sprintf("  df_residual (denominator):   %d\n", df_res))
cat(sprintf("  df_total:                    %d\n\n", df_total))

# Step 3: Noncentrality parameter
# Formula: λ = f² × (n - p - 1) / p
# where f² = R² / (1 - R²) is the effect size (Cohen's f-squared)
f_squared <- R_sq / (1 - R_sq)
lambda <- f_squared * df_res / df_reg

cat("Step 3: Noncentrality parameter\n")
cat(sprintf("  Cohen's f² = R²/(1-R²) = %.6f\n", f_squared))
cat(sprintf("  λ = f² × (n-p-1)/p = %.6f\n\n", lambda))

  # such that cor(Y, X) has squared multiple correlation = ρ²

# H0: R² = 0 vs H1: R² > 0 (with ρ = 0.30)

df_denominator <- n - p - 1  # degrees of freedom for residual

  # such that cor(Y, X) has squared multiple correlation = ρ²
